candidate.name: Justin Foster
candidate.summary: I'm a licensed property underwriter with 6+ years in property and personal lines, including two years underwriting homeowners risks in the E&S market, and I'm surplus lines licensed in all 50 states.

Earned a 98% quality assurance score for 2025 on surplus lines files, where every form and filing must be exact
Three-time President's Club producer at State Farm with over $1 million in premium written
